description: Réseau de transport urbain - CA Vichy Communauté - 2018 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ids.craig.fr. Mobivie urban transport lines and stops. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Urban transport network - CA Vichy Community - 2018" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Vichy communauté, open data, mobilité, lignes, MOBIVIE, transports. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
